Hero text is placed at the bottom, with a wide, low visual element spanning the top two-thirds of the post, presented as a wide landscape.
Hero text is small and positioned in a top corner, leaving most of the post for a large, central visual element that dominates the frame, viewed head-on.

The hero text is in a narrow column on the left, with the 2.5D diagram filling the entire right side, showing a close-up of a specific component.
The 2.5D diagram is a large, central element, with the hero text positioned in a clear negative space at the bottom, slightly to one side.
The hero text is placed over a subtle, low-contrast area of the 2.5D diagram, which occupies the full frame, offering a wide, contextual view.
The 2.5D diagram is a small, focused element in the upper right, with the hero text dominating the left and bottom, creating significant negative space.

modelo-anatomia.textura: The background surface is smooth, resembling a cool, light paper, with subtle gradients suggesting depth. Illustrations feature fine, crisp lines and soft, volumetric rendering.
modelo-anatomia.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a cool, bright light, emphasizing clarity and detail, with specific elements within the diagram appearing to emit a soft, internal glow.
modelo-anatomia.papeisDasCores: A cool, light background dominates, with dark text. A single, clear accent color is used for emphasis within the diagram and for key words, while a secondary, warm accent is reserved for internal illustrative elements only.
modelo-anatomia.evitar: Do not use any additional accent colors beyond the designated cool and warm ones. Avoid realistic photos, emojis, or app icons, and never place text too close to the edges.

modelo-cinema.tipografia: A high-contrast serif like Cormorant Garamond is used for all spoken text, with italic for emphasis, terms, and questions; a wide-tracked uppercase geometric sans like Jost is used for small, spaced credit-like text.
modelo-cinema.textura: A subtle film grain and soft vignette are applied only to the subject-related image, while text and background areas remain clean and smooth.
modelo-cinema.luz: The overall scene is dimly lit, with a warm, low-key light source illuminating the subject-related image, creating soft shadows and depth.
modelo-cinema.papeisDasCores: A dark background color dominates, light text provides high contrast, and a warm accent color is used sparingly for emphasis, line art, and credit-like text.
modelo-cinema.evitar: Do not include any bright glows behind the subject, light leaks, film scratches, emojis, text outlines, or colorful gradients. Avoid any UI elements or empty frames.

modelo-clinico.atmosfera: Precise and analytical, evoking a modern clinical or scientific consultation. It feels premium and trustworthy, like an expert explaining complex information with clarity.
modelo-clinico.elementoVisual: A stylized, subject-related illustration or diagram, rendered with clean lines and minimal detail, functions as the central 'examination' element. This element can be a technical cutaway, a conceptual diagram, or an abstract representation of an idea, always filling the space where a presenter's face would be. It visually interprets the hero sentence, acting as a magnified view of the core concept.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with the visual element filling the top half of the post, seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint.
The hero text is positioned in a narrow column on the left, while the visual element occupies the entire right two-thirds of the post, shown in a close-up, detailed view.
The hero text is placed within the visual element itself, which is a large, central circular diagram, with the text integrated into its structure.
The hero text is small and aligned to the top right, with the visual element dominating the entire post from a wide, expansive perspective.
The hero text is centered horizontally, overlaid on the lower portion of a medium-scale visual element that fills the upper two-thirds of the post.
modelo-clinico.tipografia: A single geometric sans-serif typeface is used throughout, with varying weights: extra bold for key terms and numbers, bold for titles and main items, and semibold for labels and captions. Tracking is consistently tight, and text is always measured to fit balanced lines.
modelo-clinico.textura: Surfaces are clean and smooth, with occasional subtle light cool gray grid lines or rounded stroke ends on illustrative elements. There is no visible paper grain or glass effect.
modelo-clinico.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a cool, diffused light, creating minimal soft shadows and maintaining high contrast for readability.
modelo-clinico.papeisDasCores: The background is a light cool tone, text is a dark near-black, and a primary accent color is used for outlines, numbers, and positive indicators, with a strong contrasting accent color reserved exclusively for negative indicators.
modelo-clinico.evitar: Do not include any photographic elements, stock images, or real-world objects that carry text like price tags or signs. Avoid any elements that suggest a video interface, such as progress bars or play buttons.

modelo-constelacao.atmosfera: An academic, premium, and precise mood, reminiscent of vintage scientific atlases. It evokes a sense of discovery and guided exploration.
modelo-constelacao.elementoVisual: A stylized, flat celestial map forms the background, featuring a subtle grid, dotted star fields, and a graduated border. Ideas are rendered as glowing points of light, connected by thin lines, forming abstract constellations that visually interpret the hero sentence.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered on the lower half, with a subject-related abstract texture filling a prominent round frame in the upper right, balanced by ample negative space.
Hero text is positioned in a narrow left column, with the abstract constellation visual element filling the entire right side of the post, viewed from a wide perspective.

Hero text is small and placed at the top, while a large, detailed abstract constellation, viewed from a close perspective, dominates the center, with a round subject-related texture in the lower left.
Hero text is integrated within the abstract constellation lines in the center, with a round subject-related texture in the upper left, leaving the bottom clear.
Hero text is large and at the bottom, with the abstract constellation visual element filling the entire upper two-thirds of the post, featuring a round subject-related texture in the upper right.
modelo-constelacao.tipografia: A high-contrast serif typeface like Spectral is used for the main hero text, with key words in a heavier weight or italic. A wide-tracked uppercase geometric sans like Reddit Sans is used for any secondary, smaller text, maintaining clear hierarchy.
modelo-constelacao.textura: The background features a subtle, dark, almost-black surface with a fine coordinate grid, faint dotted patterns suggesting a star field, and a dark vignette at the edges. Surfaces are flat with no visible grain.
modelo-constelacao.luz: The scene is lit with a single, focused light source that highlights the glowing elements, creating a strong contrast against the dark background, with no ambient light.
modelo-constelacao.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light, warm text and glowing elements. A single accent color is used sparingly for guiding lines and focal points.
modelo-constelacao.evitar: Do not use any photos, colored gradients, text outlines, or any visual elements that appear to be shaking or flashing. Avoid any element that looks like a price tag, sign, or screen.

modelo-conversa.atmosfera: Modern, clean, and premium, evoking the familiar intimacy of a well-designed messaging app. It feels immediate and direct, like a personal exchange.
modelo-conversa.elementoVisual: Stylized line art icons or abstract shapes, rendered with clean, single-stroke outlines and flat fills. These elements are generic and adaptable, illustrating concepts like success, failure, or a shared item, and are integrated into the message bubble or as a card.
composicoes: Hero text centered within a large message bubble, which is placed over a dark background with a subtle, subject-related texture filling the lower half of the frame.
Hero text in a narrow column on the left, with a large, abstract visual element filling the right two-thirds of the frame, rendered as a shared card.
Hero text as a 'fixed message' at the top, with a series of smaller message bubbles below it, each containing a simple line art icon or a short phrase, all over a dark background.
Hero text large and central, with a prominent line art icon or abstract shape behind it, slightly transparent, filling the middle of the frame, all on a dark background.
Hero text at the bottom right, contained within a message bubble, with a large, subject-related texture filling the entire background, and a small, subtle line art icon in the top left.
modelo-conversa.tipografia: A highly legible geometric sans-serif, like Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, is used throughout. Text in message bubbles uses a medium weight, while titles and highlights use bold to extra-bold weights, all in mixed case with standard tracking.
modelo-conversa.textura: The background features a very subtle, dark, uniform texture, like a fine grain or brushed metal, providing depth without distraction. Message bubbles are flat and opaque.
modelo-conversa.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a soft, ambient light, creating minimal shadows and maintaining a clean, digital aesthetic.
modelo-conversa.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light text for readability. The accent color is used for key messages, highlights, and success indicators, providing a warm contrast.
modelo-conversa.evitar: Do not use any gradients, bright glows, outlined letters, or complex photographic elements. Avoid any elements that mimic real-world UI like price tags or screens, or empty frames.

modelo-convite.atmosfera: Elegant and calm, evoking premium, tangible paper goods. It feels like a cherished keepsake, not a fleeting digital frame.
modelo-convite.elementoVisual: A central, subject-related image or texture fills an arched frame, resembling a formal invitation. Supporting elements like stacked or fanned-out cards, a satin ribbon with markers, a wax seal, and a numerical dial are arranged around it, all rendered as if made of fine paper and materials.
composicoes: The hero text is a large calligraphic title at the bottom of a prominent arched invitation, which fills most of the frame, with a wax seal at its base.

The hero text is a smaller calligraphic header on a card, which is part of a stack of cards on one side, with a numerical dial and a ribbon on the opposite side, and a smaller arched image in the top corner.
The hero text is centered on a single, large card that dominates the frame, with a smaller arched image in the top corner and a subtle ribbon element at the bottom.
The hero text is a prominent number within a circular dial on one side, with a smaller arched image on the opposite side and a stack of cards fanned out below.

The hero text is a short calligraphic phrase stamped by a wax seal, which is placed over a large arched image that fills the entire background, with only the edges of fanned cards visible at the sides.
modelo-convite.tipografia: Key words and short titles use an elegant, flowing script like Great Vibes. Numbers, labels, and text with symbols use a wide-tracked uppercase serif like Cinzel. Body text, phrases, and questions use a readable serif like EB Garamond in regular or italic weights, with generous line spacing.
modelo-convite.textura: Surfaces mimic fine cotton paper with a subtle grain, laid over a linen background with a visible weave. Satin ribbon has a soft sheen, and wax seals appear slightly textured.
modelo-convite.luz: Soft, diffused light from the top-left creates subtle shadows and highlights, emphasizing the paper's texture and the depth of the layered elements.
modelo-convite.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, providing a rich base for light paper elements. Text is a dark, warm tone, while a cool accent color is used sparingly for the wax seal, dial, and small decorative elements.
modelo-convite.evitar: Do not include any decorative gradients, metallic effects, outlines on text, emojis, or stickers. Avoid any visual elements that would carry writing, such as price tags or screens, or empty frames.

modelo-criativo.atmosfera: Modern, clean, and highly structured. It conveys a premium, trustworthy, and direct sales message through precise visual hierarchy.
modelo-criativo.elementoVisual: A central 'glass stage' composed of translucent, layered glass cards with subtle depth and a soft glow. These cards display a subject-related image, scene, or texture, which can be a hero product, a demonstrative photo, or an illustrative icon.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered at the top, with a prominent glass card below it filling the lower two-thirds of the post, showcasing a subject-related image at a medium scale.
The hero text is positioned in a narrow column on the left, while a full-height glass card on the right displays a large-scale subject-related image, creating strong negative space on the left.
The hero text is small and placed at the bottom, with a large glass card occupying the entire upper portion of the post, featuring a subject-related image at a wide, expansive viewpoint.
The hero text is centered over a large, slightly tilted glass card that fills most of the post, with the subject-related image integrated within the card at a medium scale.
The hero text is placed at the top right, with a smaller, square glass card in the bottom left corner showcasing a close-up subject-related image, leaving significant negative space.
modelo-criativo.tipografia: A single geometric sans-serif typeface, Sora, is used across all text elements. Key words and headlines are rendered in extra bold (800) with tight tracking, while supporting text uses bold (700) or semi-bold (600) weights with standard tracking.
modelo-criativo.textura: Surfaces are predominantly smooth, translucent glass with a subtle blur effect, a faint light border, and a soft highlight on the upper left corner, suggesting depth and a premium feel.
modelo-criativo.luz: The scene is evenly lit, with soft, ambient light that highlights the glass elements and their subtle shadows, creating a clean and focused presentation.
modelo-criativo.papeisDasCores: The background is a dark, cool tone, while text on glass cards is a contrasting light tone. A single accent color, either a warm signal tone or the client's brand color, is used for key words and graphic elements.
modelo-criativo.evitar: Do not use generic stock photos that only 'somewhat' match the subject, or different products across multiple layouts. Never place text over the edge of a glass card or use any real brand logos.

modelo-curriculo.atmosfera: A precise, authentic, and professional aesthetic, evoking a timeless analog review process.
modelo-curriculo.elementoVisual: A subject-related image, scene, or texture fills a paper-like adhesive note shape. This element is rendered as a flat, realistic photograph or illustration, providing context for the hero sentence without being a direct depiction of its content.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered on a white paper sheet, with a smaller adhesive note containing the visual element positioned in the top right corner, pointing to the text.
The hero text is positioned in a narrow column on the left side of the white paper sheet, with the visual element filling a large adhesive note that occupies the entire right margin.
The hero text is small and aligned to the top left of the white paper sheet, with the visual element filling a large adhesive note that dominates the bottom half of the post.
The hero text is large and centered at the top of the white paper sheet, with the visual element filling a prominent adhesive note that spans the full width of the post below it.
The hero text is small and centered at the bottom of the white paper sheet, with the visual element filling a large, central adhesive note that takes up most of the upper space.
modelo-curriculo.tipografia: The main text uses an elegant serif typeface for titles and body, with a strong, equal-width numeral style. Section titles and labels use a wide-tracked uppercase geometric sans, while handwritten notes and accents use a casual, legible script typeface.
modelo-curriculo.textura: The post features a subtle paper texture for the main sheet and a slightly warmer, creased paper texture for the adhesive note, with soft shadows suggesting depth on a cool background surface.
modelo-curriculo.luz: The scene is evenly lit from above, creating soft, diffused shadows that define the paper elements without harsh contrasts.
modelo-curriculo.papeisDasCores: The background is a cool dark tone, the main paper is light, and the adhesive note is a warm light tone. Text is a dark neutral, with a single saturated accent color used for handwritten marks and highlights.
modelo-curriculo.evitar: Do not use colorful gradients, glowing effects, text outlines, emojis, or colored highlighters. Avoid any interface elements, app icons, or contact information.

modelo-demo.atmosfera: Modern, functional, and highly informative. This style conveys a premium yet accessible feel, suitable for demonstrating concepts or products.
modelo-demo.elementoVisual: The core visual element is a clean, full-bleed digital interface or a subject-related photographic scene, rendered flat or with subtle depth. It serves as a direct visual representation of the hero text's idea, filling the designated area completely.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed digital interface filling the top 44% of the canvas and a dark background below.
Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed digital interface or subject image occupying the entire 4:5 canvas.
Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed subject-related photographic scene occupying the entire 4:5 canvas, viewed from a slightly closer perspective.

Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed digital interface or subject image occupying the top 44% of the canvas, and a thin accent strip centered at the interface's bottom edge.
Hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed digital interface or subject image occupying the entire 4:5 canvas, featuring a prominent cursor icon pointing to a key area.
modelo-demo.tipografia: The hero text uses a condensed display sans-serif in uppercase, with a dark outline and shadow for strong contrast. Supporting text within the visual element uses a wide geometric sans-serif, typically in a bold weight and light color.
modelo-demo.textura: Surfaces are clean and digital, with no visible grain or paper texture. Depth is minimal, primarily conveyed through subtle shadows on text elements.
modelo-demo.luz: The lighting is even and bright on the visual element, mimicking a screen display or well-lit scene, with a dark, uniform background providing contrast.
modelo-demo.papeisDasCores: A very dark background dominates, with light text for readability. A single vibrant accent color is used sparingly for emphasis, and the hero text uses a warm, medium-value color with a dark outline.
modelo-demo.evitar: Do not use filters, vignettes, blur, or color overlays on any photographic elements. Avoid animated zooms, emojis, or any hand-drawn interface elements.

modelo-devocional.atmosfera: This style evokes a calm, reflective mood, like a cherished page from a devotional book. It feels premium and timeless, designed for quiet contemplation.
modelo-devocional.elementoVisual: The primary visual elements are simple, fine line-art illustrations that literally depict a key word from the sentence, or a subject-related texture or scene filling the lower frame. These elements are rendered with clean, minimal strokes or as a subtle, ambient background.
composicoes: The hero text is centered vertically on a large page, with a subtle line-art illustration appearing above it, scaled to fit the top half of the page.
The hero text is positioned in the upper half of the page, with a large, abstract texture or scene filling the entire lower half of the post.
A single, large line-art illustration dominates the center of the page, with the hero text placed compactly in a clear area within its negative space.
The hero text is aligned to the left, occupying the middle third of the page, with a small, detailed line-art drawing positioned as an accent in the upper right corner.
The hero text is presented in a prominent, large scale in the center of the page, with a subtle, subject-related texture filling the entire background.
modelo-devocional.tipografia: EB Garamond (a high-contrast serif) is used for all main text, with varying weights (medium for body, semibold for emphasis) and generous line spacing. Titles and references use a custom small caps style (Manrope, a wide geometric sans, is reserved for minor branding elements not present in the still post).
modelo-devocional.textura: The background features a subtle, warm light-toned paper texture with a gentle, slow drift, suggesting an aged parchment. Fine dust motes are visible, softly illuminated.
modelo-devocional.luz: The scene is lit by a soft, warm light source that subtly shifts across the background, creating gentle highlights and shadows, especially behind emphasized text.
modelo-devocional.papeisDasCores: A warm light background dominates, with dark text and a muted accent color used for ornaments, emphasized words, and line-art illustrations.
modelo-devocional.evitar: Do not include any metallic effects, strong light rays, angelic imagery, crosses, doves, stained glass, baroque frames, or cloud-filled sky backgrounds. Avoid any text with shadows or overly bright, contrasting elements.

modelo-dicionario.atmosfera: Classic and authoritative, evoking a premium, well-researched academic publication. It feels timeless and sophisticated.
modelo-dicionario.elementoVisual: A stylized, monochromatic illustration or technical drawing, rendered with fine lines, cross-hatching, and stippling, fills the designated image area. This element conceptually illustrates the hero sentence, appearing as a detailed engraving or diagram from a classic reference book.
composicoes: The hero text is centered on the lower half of the page, with a large, framed illustrative element occupying the top half, scaled to fill its frame completely.
The hero text is positioned in a narrow column on the left, with the illustrative element filling the entire right two-thirds of the post, viewed from a close perspective.
The hero text is large and centered over a subtle, full-bleed illustrative background element, which is scaled down and softly integrated into the overall composition.
A prominent illustrative element is placed on the left, with the hero text aligned to the right, occupying a wide column and scaled for strong impact.
The hero text is small and positioned at the bottom right, while a large, detailed illustrative element dominates the top and left, viewed from an elevated perspective.
modelo-dicionario.tipografia: A high-contrast serif typeface, like Source Serif 4, is used for the main text, with bold weights for key terms and regular italic for explanatory phrases. A wide-tracked geometric sans-serif, like Source Sans 3, is reserved for uppercase labels, numbers, and page indicators, ensuring clear hierarchy.
modelo-dicionario.textura: The background features a subtle, warm paper texture with a soft shadow on one side, mimicking a book's spine, while other elements appear as dark ink on this surface.
modelo-dicionario.luz: The scene is evenly lit, suggesting a well-lit reading environment, with soft, diffused light that highlights the paper texture and ink details without harsh shadows.
modelo-dicionario.papeisDasCores: The background is a light, warm tone, dominating the palette; text is a dark, cool tone; and a single, deep accent color is used sparingly for highlights, such as underlines or specific numerical indicators.
modelo-dicionario.evitar: Do not use bright, saturated gradients, emojis, generic icons, or any photographic elements. Avoid text outlines, drop shadows on text, or any visual effects that detract from a classic, printed aesthetic.

modelo-dossie.atmosfera: A serious, meticulous, and analytical mood, evoking a sense of unraveling a mystery or presenting evidence. It feels vintage and grounded, suitable for any subject requiring detailed explanation.
modelo-dossie.elementoVisual: A flat lay composition of various paper documents (manila folders, typed reports, handwritten notes, photos, newspaper clippings) pinned to a dark, textured cork board. A thin accent-colored string connects key elements, visually linking the ideas presented in the hero text.
composicoes: The hero text is centered on a large report document, which is pinned prominently in the middle of the cork board, surrounded by smaller, related documents.
The hero text is placed in a column on the left side of the post, with a large, detailed close-up of a single document filling the right two-thirds of the frame.
The hero text is integrated into a handwritten note or post-it, pinned near the top of the board, with a wide view of the entire investigation board below it.
The hero text is presented as a typed title on a manila folder, positioned at the bottom of the frame, with a collection of smaller evidence pieces arranged above it.

The hero text is stamped with an accent-colored seal on a central memo, with the accent-colored string converging from several surrounding documents towards this central piece, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective.
modelo-dossie.tipografia: Titles, stamps, and numbers use a bold, geometric sans-serif typeface with tight tracking; body text and items use a medium weight of the same sans-serif. Short labels like 'REPORT' or 'PROOF A' use an uppercase typewriter-style serif with wider tracking, while a casual marker script is reserved for question marks.
modelo-dossie.textura: The background is a dark, coarse cork board with visible grain, overlaid with various paper textures (smooth report paper, fibrous manila, slightly crinkled notes) and the subtle sheen of metal pins.
modelo-dossie.luz: The scene is lit from above with a focused, warm light, creating soft shadows under the paper elements and highlighting the texture of the cork board.
modelo-dossie.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light, warm-toned papers carrying the text. A single, strong accent color is reserved exclusively for the connecting string and a prominent stamp.
modelo-dossie.evitar: Do not include any real brand logos or specific product names; use generic icons. Avoid using the accent color for anything other than the string and stamp, and never use a dark text on a dark background or a light text on a light background. Do not use condensed fonts or long passages of typewriter text.

modelo-espelho.atmosfera: Discreet luxury, high-end magazine aesthetic. Calm and meaningful, premium.
modelo-espelho.elementoVisual: A symmetrical line-art illustration or a detailed technical drawing of an object or concept, rendered with fine, precise lines. This element stands on a thin horizontal dividing line, often featuring numbered points or highlighted areas related to the hero text. The illustration or a related scene fills the upper portion of the post, while a complementary texture or abstract visual fills the lower portion.
composicoes: Hero text is centered and large in the upper half, with a symmetrical line-art illustration filling the background behind it, anchored by a thin horizontal line. The lower half features a subtle, abstract texture.

Hero text is aligned left in a narrow column in the upper half, beside a large, detailed line-art illustration that occupies most of the upper space. A thin horizontal line divides the post, with a complementary texture below.

Hero text is small and positioned at the bottom, centered above a thin horizontal line. A large, symmetrical line-art illustration fills the entire upper two-thirds of the post, with a subtle texture in the bottom third.

Hero text is integrated into the line-art illustration itself, appearing within a highlighted area or as a label for a specific part. The illustration dominates the upper half, with the horizontal line and a texture below.

Hero text is centered and large, overlaid on a subtle, abstract texture that fills the entire post. A thin horizontal line runs through the center, with a small, symmetrical line-art illustration placed above it, off to one side.
modelo-espelho.tipografia: Elegant high-contrast serif like Bodoni Moda is used for titles, items, and numbers, with emphasis on italic weights for notes and phrases, featuring tight tracking. A geometric sans-serif like Jost is used for uppercase labels and units, with wide tracking.
modelo-espelho.textura: Surfaces are smooth and clean, with a subtle, fine dotted pattern used for highlighted areas within illustrations, suggesting a veiled or illuminated effect.
modelo-espelho.luz: The scene is evenly lit with soft, diffused light, creating minimal shadows and a sophisticated, understated feel.
modelo-espelho.papeisDasCores: A light, warm background dominates, with dark text and lines providing strong contrast. A single, rich accent color is used sparingly for key elements like dividing lines, points, and emphasis.
modelo-espelho.evitar: Do not use colorful gradients, shadows, glows behind elements, text with outlines, or emojis. Avoid any elements that suggest a video interface, such as progress bars or UI chrome.

modelo-estudio.atmosfera: A well-produced podcast aesthetic, modern and premium. The mood is dark, focused, and impactful.
modelo-estudio.elementoVisual: A subject-related abstract image or texture fills a prominent, rectangular frame with slightly rounded corners and a thin light border. This element serves as a visual anchor, dynamically changing its position and scale to interact with the hero text.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered at the bottom, with the visual element filling the top two-thirds of the post, slightly scaled down.
The hero text is large and centered on the left, with the visual element filling the right two-thirds of the post, presented as a medium close-up.
The hero text is large and centered at the top, with the visual element filling the bottom two-thirds of the post, presented as a wide shot.
The hero text is large and centered over the visual element, which fills the entire background as a subtle, wide shot.
The hero text is large and centered on the right, with the visual element filling the left two-thirds of the post, presented as a medium shot.
modelo-estudio.tipografia: A robust geometric sans-serif is used for the hero text, with heavy weight and tight tracking. A monospaced sans-serif in uppercase, medium weight, is used for smaller, functional labels like 'EPISODE' or 'CHAPTER'.
modelo-estudio.textura: Surfaces are smooth and clean, with a subtle, dark gradient in the background. There is no visible grain or paper texture.
modelo-estudio.luz: The scene is lit with a low-key, dramatic light that emphasizes depth and contrast, with a single, strong accent light source.
modelo-estudio.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light text for readability. A single, vibrant accent color is used sparingly for highlights and key elements.
modelo-estudio.evitar: Do not use multiple accent colors, color gradients, or any glowing effects behind elements. Avoid any elements that appear to be UI chrome, such as progress bars or buttons.

modelo-etapas.atmosfera: Structured, informative, and direct. It conveys a modern, premium feel for educational content.
modelo-etapas.elementoVisual: The primary visual element is a static screenshot or a stylized illustration of a digital interface, such as a web page, application, or data table. This element serves as 'proof on screen' for the hero text, filling a designated area of the canvas.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered at the top, with the visual element filling the bottom two-thirds of the post, cropped to show relevant detail.
Hero text is small and positioned in a thin column on the left, with the visual element occupying the entire right two-thirds of the post, shown at a medium scale.
Hero text is large and centered over the top half of a full-bleed visual element, which is rendered with a slightly desaturated or blurred effect to ensure legibility.
Hero text is small and aligned to the bottom right, with the visual element presented as a large, detailed close-up filling the top three-quarters of the post.
Hero text is centered horizontally in the middle of the post, with the visual element appearing as a smaller, contained rectangle above it, and ample negative space below.
modelo-etapas.tipografia: A robust, geometric sans-serif typeface is used throughout. Key words in the hero text are rendered in a heavy weight, uppercase, with light tracking, while supporting text uses a medium weight, lowercase, with standard tracking.
modelo-etapas.textura: Surfaces are clean and smooth, with no visible grain or paper texture. The overall impression is digital and polished.
modelo-etapas.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a cool, neutral light, ensuring clarity and legibility of all elements without harsh shadows or strong highlights.
modelo-etapas.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates the post, with light text for high contrast. A single warm accent color is used sparingly for emphasis or small graphic elements.
modelo-etapas.evitar: Do not use any animated transitions, glowing effects, or colored words. Avoid any elements that appear 'too edited' or overly decorative, maintaining a clean and functional aesthetic.

modelo-etiqueta.atmosfera: Informative and practical, with a clear, structured presentation. It feels like a premium, well-organized retail display.
modelo-etiqueta.elementoVisual: The core visual is a stylized, multi-tiered shelf structure, rendered with a clean, flat aesthetic, suggesting paper cutouts or light 3D forms. Each tier holds a subject-related object or a typographic card, and a hanging label with a prominent number. The hero sentence is integrated into the background or a dedicated text area, complementing the tiered display.
composicoes: The hero text is centered at the top, above a three-tiered shelf structure that fills the lower two-thirds of the frame, with the visual elements on each step.
The hero text occupies a narrow column on the left, with a two-tiered shelf structure filling the right two-thirds of the frame, angled slightly upwards.
A single, large visual element sits centrally, with the hero text placed prominently across its lower third, and a small hanging label above the element.
The hero text is large and centered, with a three-tiered shelf structure scaled down and positioned in the bottom right corner, featuring small visual elements.
The hero text is placed in the upper right quadrant, with a two-tiered shelf structure filling the entire bottom half of the frame, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective.
modelo-etiqueta.tipografia: A single, wide, and rounded geometric sans-serif typeface is used throughout, with clear, legible numerals. Key numbers and labels use a heavy weight, while supporting text uses a medium to bold weight, all in regular case with standard tracking.
modelo-etiqueta.textura: The background features a subtle, perforated panel texture. Labels and cards have a smooth, matte paper texture. Shelf fronts have a light wood grain, and shadows under elements are soft and defined.
modelo-etiqueta.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a soft, diffused light, creating gentle shadows beneath the visual elements, suggesting an interior space.

modelo-torre.tipografia: Elegant high-contrast serif for large numbers and key names, with wide-tracked uppercase geometric sans for labels and smaller text. Titles and phrases use a bold sans-serif with slightly tight tracking.
modelo-torre.textura: Smooth, reflective surfaces for the 3D elements, with subtle light bloom on windows and glowing accents, creating a sense of depth and polish.
modelo-torre.luz: A cool, dark ambient light from a night sky, with warm amber backlighting from distant city lights and cool moonlight creating soft shadows.
modelo-torre.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light text and a single, thin, warm accent color used for highlights, lines, and specific elements; photos are never tinted.
modelo-torre.evitar: Never show real brand logos or map screenshots. Avoid any element that would carry writing like price tags, signs, or screens, unless it is the primary visual element for the hero text itself. Do not use neon, strong glows, or rainbow gradients.

modelo-transformacao.atmosfera: Calm, precise, and results-oriented, evoking a premium home magazine aesthetic.
modelo-transformacao.elementoVisual: A large, high-resolution photo or detailed illustration depicting a 'before and after' scenario, split by a vertical line or 'curtain' effect. The image should be a generic scene, object, or texture related to the sentence, rendered realistically or with a clean, modern illustration style.
composicoes: Hero text is centered on a light card at chest height, with the visual element filling the entire background at a medium scale.
Hero text is in a light card at the bottom center, with the visual element filling the top two-thirds of the post, showing a focused detail.
Hero text is in a light card in the upper left, with the visual element filling the entire background, zoomed in to highlight a specific area.
Hero text is in a light card in the lower right, with the visual element filling the entire background, showing a wider view of the scene.
Hero text is in a light card in a narrow column on the left, with the visual element filling the remaining two-thirds of the post, presenting a balanced composition.
modelo-transformacao.tipografia: A single wide, rounded geometric sans-serif family is used: main words in extra bold, definitions in bold, and details in medium weight. Labels like 'BEFORE/AFTER' are uppercase with wide tracking.
modelo-transformacao.textura: Smooth, clean surfaces with subtle, soft shadows; a linen-like background and paper-like cards provide a tactile, refined feel.
modelo-transformacao.luz: Even, soft ambient lighting with gentle, diffused shadows, creating a clear and inviting scene.
modelo-transformacao.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light text on light cards; a specific accent color is used for emphasis and 'after' elements.
modelo-transformacao.evitar: Do not use unaligned photos, small text or logos, or two markers in the same place. Never promise health results in content captions.

modelo-versus.atmosfera: Energetic, competitive, and decisive. A modern, premium feel for clear-cut comparisons.
modelo-versus.elementoVisual: Two large, inclined panels dominate the composition, facing each other with a diagonal gap between them. Each panel is filled completely by a distinct, clean photographic image or a stylized graphic representing one of the two contrasting subjects. The hero sentence is integrated as a bold statement, often interacting with these panels.
composicoes: The hero text is centered and large, overlaid on the diagonal gap between two full-height inclined panels, which feature subject images at a medium scale.
The hero text occupies a wide, short bar at the bottom, while the two inclined panels with subject images are scaled down and positioned in the upper half, with ample negative space below.
One inclined panel with its subject image fills the left side of the post, while the hero text is stacked vertically in a narrow column on the right, against a solid background.
The hero text is placed within a prominent, stylized paper card at the bottom, with two smaller, inclined subject image panels positioned above it, creating a sense of a 'verdict' display.
A single, large inclined panel with a subject image fills most of the post, with the hero text positioned boldly over its lower third, allowing the image to be the primary focus.
modelo-versus.tipografia: A single wide, firm geometric sans serif like Kanit is used. Key words and titles are rendered in extra bold italic uppercase, while supporting text uses a bold italic weight, maintaining a strong, poster-like legibility.
modelo-versus.textura: Surfaces are flat with hard, short shadows beneath elements, mimicking a printed poster. A subtle, moving diagonal line pattern is present in the background, suggesting dynamic motion.
modelo-versus.luz: The scene is evenly lit, with a clear distinction between foreground elements and the background. Shadows are sharp and defined, not diffused.
modelo-versus.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, providing contrast for light text and vibrant subject images. One primary accent color is used for key highlights and separators, while two distinct contrasting colors define the two opposing sides.
modelo-versus.evitar: Do not use condensed fonts, text outlines, or blurred text shadows. Avoid adding decorative icons or emojis outside of specific, defined roles. Never use more than two contrasting subjects or more than four profile cards.

modelo-viral.atmosfera: This style conveys a modern, dynamic, and premium feel, designed for high retention and broad applicability across any subject. It is clean and rigorous, emphasizing clear communication through strong visual elements.
modelo-viral.elementoVisual: The core visual element is a high-quality, subject-related image, scene, or texture, rendered as a realistic photograph or a clean 3D object. It directly illustrates the hero sentence, either filling the entire frame or presented within a distinct card.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered at the bottom of the frame, with a full-bleed subject image filling the entire background.
The hero text is large and centered in the middle of the frame, overlaid on a full-bleed subject image that is slightly zoomed in.
The hero text is large and positioned in a dark background block at the bottom, with a prominent subject image filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
The hero text is large and placed in a dark background block on the left side, with a subject image filling the entire right two-thirds of the frame.
The hero text is large and centered at the top, with a subject image contained within a light-bordered card, centered below it on a dark background.
modelo-viral.tipografia: A single wide, full-bodied geometric sans-serif typeface is used throughout, primarily in uppercase and extra bold weight for the hero text. Key words and numbers are rendered in the heaviest weight, while supporting text uses slightly lighter weights, maintaining clear hierarchy.
modelo-viral.textura: Surfaces are smooth and clean, with a subtle, almost imperceptible film grain on the dark background areas. Visual elements are sharp and detailed, without any paper or chalk textures.
modelo-viral.luz: The lighting is clean and even, with a slight contrast to define forms. There are no harsh shadows or overly dramatic light sources, ensuring clarity and focus on the subject.
modelo-viral.papeisDasCores: The background is predominantly dark, almost black. The hero text is light, with a vibrant accent color used for specific highlights or as a thin border on cards.
modelo-viral.evitar: Do not use more than three words in the hero text, or place it on two lines. Avoid any zoom effects or visual elements that appear to 'shake'. Do not use decorative icons or emojis, and never change the accent color for different parts of the post.

modelo-visor.atmosfera: Precise, technical, and discreet, evoking a modern, premium feel. The aesthetic is clean and functional, like a professional camera display.
modelo-visor.elementoVisual: A simple, illustrative scene or texture, rendered with soft shadows and neutral warm tones, fills any area where a person or video frame would be. This element metaphorically represents the subject being 'adjusted' or 'focused' upon, directly relating to the hero sentence.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered, with a full-bleed visual element as its background, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective.
The hero text is in a narrow column on the left, with a large, detailed visual element dominating the right side of the frame.
The hero text is small and positioned at the bottom, with a wide, expansive visual element filling the top two-thirds of the post.
The hero text is integrated into a dark, semi-transparent panel on the left, with a zoomed-in visual element filling the rest of the frame.
The hero text is placed over a large, central visual element, with minimal dark background space at the top and bottom.
modelo-visor.tipografia: A geometric sans-serif (Hanken Grotesk) is used for the main text, with varying weights (bold for titles, medium/semibold for body) and normal tracking. A monospaced sans-serif (Chivo Mono) is used for smaller, technical labels, set in uppercase with wide tracking.
modelo-visor.textura: Surfaces are smooth and clean, with subtle, soft shadows and a hint of translucent glass effect for overlay elements, creating depth without heavy grain.
modelo-visor.luz: The scene is lit with soft, diffused light, creating gentle gradients and minimal harsh reflections, emphasizing clarity and precision.
modelo-visor.papeisDasCores: The background is very dark, text is light, and a single cool light accent highlights active or successful elements, while a distinct warm light accent is reserved for warnings.
modelo-visor.evitar: Do not include any glowing effects, colored gradients, light leaks, full white flashes, or film grain. Avoid placing any elements over the main subject or distorting its shape.

modelo-wireframe.atmosfera: Precise, measured, and calm, evoking a professional design studio aesthetic. This style is premium and analytical.
modelo-wireframe.elementoVisual: A stylized mobile phone screen or a design canvas frame, rendered with clean, flat graphics. The screen can be in a wireframe state (geometric blocks, placeholder lines, an 'X' for images) or a clean, colored state (flat illustration in brand tones). A distinct rounded shape with a pointed corner, originally for the presenter, is filled with a subject-related abstract texture or scene.
composicoes: Hero text centered over a large, clean mobile screen with a flat illustration, the pointed-corner shape in the top left as a subtle background element.
Hero text in a narrow column on the left, a wireframe mobile screen on the right, and the pointed-corner shape as a small, contained element in the top right.
Hero text large and centered, overlaid on a full-bleed abstract texture filling the pointed-corner shape, with a small, clean mobile screen in the bottom right.
Hero text in a bottom-aligned bar, a large design canvas frame with placeholder cards dominating the top, and the pointed-corner shape subtly integrated into the frame's background.
Hero text in the top left, a prominent wireframe mobile screen with a specific section highlighted in an accent color, and the pointed-corner shape as a background element behind the screen.
modelo-wireframe.tipografia: A geometric sans-serif for interface elements, titles, and labels (medium to bold weight, regular tracking, mixed case). A monospaced sans-serif for measurements and numbers (regular weight, uppercase, wide tracking). A high-contrast serif for key promises or brand statements (regular weight, title case).
modelo-wireframe.textura: A dark, subtle grid of points on the background, with smooth, flat surfaces for UI elements and a soft, dark shadow under the main visual element.
modelo-wireframe.luz: Even, soft, and diffused lighting, creating minimal shadows and emphasizing clarity and precision.
modelo-wireframe.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light text for readability. Accent color is used sparingly for highlights, outlines, and specific labels, never tinting images.
modelo-wireframe.evitar: Do not use gradients, neon effects, 3D mockups, blurred backgrounds, or any real-world logos. Avoid any elements that suggest a video player or social media UI. Never use emojis or colored icons.

modelo-yap.atmosfera: Clean, modern, and professional. It conveys a serious, insightful, and trustworthy tone.
modelo-yap.elementoVisual: Subject-related photographic or illustrative images are rendered as a single, clear visual element. These images directly represent the concrete object, place, or situation mentioned in the hero text, or abstract concepts are visualized through a relevant example. The element is either a full-bleed background image or a contained image within a soft-edged card.
composicoes: Hero text is centered at the bottom, with a full-bleed subject image filling the entire frame, viewed from a slightly low angle.
Hero text is aligned to the top left, with a contained subject image card positioned to the right, leaving ample negative space.
Hero text is large and centered, with a small, contained subject image card placed below it, slightly off-center.
Hero text is in a narrow left column, with a large, contained subject image card filling the right two-thirds of the frame, viewed from a slightly high angle.
Hero text is centered at the top, with a full-bleed subject image filling the entire frame, viewed from a slightly high angle.
modelo-yap.tipografia: A geometric sans-serif typeface, Plus Jakarta Sans, is used throughout. Key words in the hero text are rendered in a bold weight (800) with a light text color, while other words are in a dark text color on an accent background. Labels and smaller text use a medium-bold weight (700).
modelo-yap.textura: Surfaces are clean and smooth, with soft-edged cards and subtle shadows, creating a sense of depth without overt texture or grain.
modelo-yap.luz: The scene is evenly lit with natural or soft studio lighting, ensuring clarity and readability without harsh shadows or dramatic effects.
modelo-yap.papeisDasCores: The background is primarily a light, warm tone, with dark text for most elements. A single accent color is used for highlights and specific text elements.
modelo-yap.evitar: Do not use filters, vignettes, blur, or color overlays on any images. Avoid text with outlines, more than one accent color, or any elements that shake, rotate, flash, or bounce.
